windows.en: Each driver builds this part of the menu from its own parent, frame and child rows, because the native menu toolkits differ (AutoHotkey menus, Hammerspoon menubar tables, the Linux tray). The other drivers carry the same controls under rows of their own: this is a menu-structure difference, not a missing control.

macos.en: Each driver's tray carries the top-level rows its platform has: the in-app updater on Linux, the suspend switch on Windows. The others reach the same ground elsewhere or not at all.
macos.fr: La zone de notification de chaque pilote porte les lignes de premier niveau que sa plateforme possède : le programme de mise à jour intégré sur Linux, l'interrupteur de suspension sur Windows. Les autres atteignent le même terrain ailleurs, ou pas du tout.
